messages:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch plan for a small-wave follow-on. We’ve got three signals: 1) Acme embedding regression (customer blocked), 2) p95 latency increase on chat endpoints, 3) UX polish request for token limit UI. Need to decide bug vs enhancement prioritization.

alex: +1. Can we get severity and repro details for Acme? Rachel, can you share the ticket?

rachel: Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/ACME-448 — embeddings intermittently returning older vectors, recall drops for their search. Customer says production is impacted.

jordan: Saw a KV cache invalidation spike around 2026-03-15 14:03 UTC in infra metrics. "kv_cache_miss_count" spiked ~1.8x. Repro seems tied to long chat sessions causing stale prefixes.

sam: UX polish is low effort — ~1 day design + 1 dev. Quick visible win if we take it.

maya: Proposal: Acme = bug (P1, hotfix), p95 latency = P2 (investigate across batching/config), UX polish = P3 (next sprint). Thoughts?

alex: I can own the Acme fix. Need SRE help to repro on staging and run canary. Est: 2 dev days + 0.5 verification. Will branch hotpatch.

jordan: I'll repro in staging and spin a 5% canary for verification. I'll also collect logs and a short runbook for rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: hotpatch/emb-fix -> staging. CI: passed. (automated)

maya: If staging looks good, plan: prod canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error. Target: staged canary by tomorrow EOD.

rachel: Success criteria for Acme: embeddings stable across 3 full-run queries, recall returns to baseline, no related errors for 12h after rollout. I'll coordinate comms with the customer once canary passes.

sam: I'll slot the token-limit UI polish into next sprint, prepping a 1-screen mock. Assigning to @sam for design handoff.

alex: Opening PR now: "hotpatch/1776549999-emb-cache-fix". Adding unit + integration test for long sessions.

jordan: After the canary, I'll run a p95 baseline test for chat to see if the latency spike is related to continuous batching changes. If so, we can quick-tune batching thresholds.

maya: Decision log: Acme = P1 hotfix (owners: alex + jordan), p95 latency = P2 (investigate, blocker if regresses further), UX polish = P3 (next sprint, owner sam). Follow-up: quick async update in this thread + 10am PST sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:
